title: Why Dingdong Dantes and Marian Rivera’s ‘Remember’ Is the Cinematic Pause We All Need Right Now
summary: Neither a prequel nor a sequel to their box-office hit "Rewind," Dingdong Dantes and Marian Rivera's new movie, " Remember," brings a comforting familiarity and a totally fresh cinematic ride.
